entities.summary: Vreme is a liberal weekly news magazine based in Belgrade, Serbia. Since its founding, the majority owner of "Vreme" has been lawyer Boris S. Popović, son of Vesna Pešić and lawyer Srđan Popović. Vreme is a magazine, established in 1990-10-01. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
